title: Clay: the actor model, and clans on it
why: Open 2, New 3, Miss 1, Importance 3, Reach 2: the rules are settled but the actor's shape is judged by whether B, C and F can add the camp and scout without new machinery; nothing like it in the code (the round goes); every turn runs it. The ladder says opus low; run off the ladder at opus medium because this is the foundation all of M2 builds on and it rewrites clans, markets' going and every reader of the round in one session. Expect: it uses most of the 90 minutes, leaves an actor interface the kiln builds on with no fixes beyond small ones, and the retro can compare the kiln's recorded clay fixes against B's camp.

title: Kiln: depletion, trails from walking, open-ended taming
why: Open 0, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 1, Reach 2: every rule and formula is given exactly (wear per food against the yield, walked-turn trails, taming past the hearth), adapted from land::hold and regrow, with the tests it must write named; it runs every turn. Haiku high fits a settled kiln on the clay.

title: Kiln: festivals forming alone, people moving, small clans merging
why: Open 0, New 3, Miss 1, Importance 1, Reach 2: forming, fading, the carry cap, the people step and merging are all specified with tie-breaks, but moving people between clans is nothing like the code has, and it touches the turn order, events and every clan count civs read. Sonnet medium matches a settled kiln with one new mechanism.

title: Kiln: the page's territories and routes; archive hex-economy and hex4x
why: Open 2, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 0, Reach 1: redrawing territory from claims and adding route lines adapts #31's canvas code, judged partly by eye from two screenshots; check.mjs is the test it writes; the archive is two folders with stubs. Haiku high: plain JS on an existing page.

title: Canvas: tune the pre-game to level off and form its own centres
why: Open 4, New 1, Miss 1, Importance 1, Reach 2: the numbers of every rule, searched for by sweeping, with a bar to meet and leave to change the clay or a kiln's form where numbers can't do it; the sweep catches mistakes; every turn runs it. On the ladder at 9: opus low for a canvas.

title: Review the piece
why: Open 2, New 1, Miss 3, Importance 1, Reach 2: checks actors.md and clans.md line by line against the engine, judges each place the builds departed from the spec, copies sweep.md's answer into the PR, and plays the page to see territories, routes and centres. 9 points: by coin, sonnet high.
